Evidence: Personal narrative, extremist recruitment, intelligence cooperation
#Aletheia #Security

Religious devotion and escape from perceived Islamophobia led a young woman into joining ISIS before she became an informant.

A young Canadian woman recounting her journey into ISIS as a teenager and her subsequent role as an informant highlights the predatory mechanics of modern extremist recruitment.

The normalization of radicalization pipelines targeting alienated youth in Western democracies before catastrophic irreversible choices occur.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing spiritual sanctuary (WHO/Metaphysical) with totalitarian subjugation (WHERE/Physical). The bait-and-switch trades religious solace for violent militant captivity.

Social Physics Analysis:
Extremist recruiters run a Smart Selfish Maneuver, leveraging identity friction and manufactured grievances to harvest vulnerable youth into violent loops.

The Trajectory: The Path of Reckoning.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Destruction. Unresolved alienation compounds until systemic intervention or catastrophe forces a reckoning.

The Unavoidable Truth: Radicalization preys upon genuine emotional isolation and societal rejection.

The Unavoidable Lie: Totalitarian death cults offer spiritual sanctuary to the disenfranchised.
